scratch_match.name: Pedestal Scratch Match
scratch_match.intro: Compare your pedestal scratch sketch to tool silhouettes. Which matches the crescent scar?

junior.hint: Junior: look for the curved crescent — not the straight pick or crowbar.

senior.hint: Match curvature and width to specialty latch tools.

onSolve.notebook: Scratch match confirmed: tungsten crescent pick — matches studio rack hook.
onSolve.monologue: Specialty hardware. Someone brought their A-game and their ego.

climate_pin.name: Climate Panel Override
climate_pin.requiresMsg: The panel wants a PIN. I need the humidity log numbers first.
climate_pin.intro: ORCHID WING — CLIMATE OVERRIDE. Enter PIN.

junior.hint: Junior tip: Day humidity (62), night (58), bench #3 → try 62583

senior.hint: Cross-reference day %, night %, and the highlighted bench number on Iris's sheet.

master.hint: Sheet smudged — day still 62, night looks like 5?, bench mark faint. Trust the blotter copy: 62583.

onSolve.notebook: Climate log unlocked: studio badge ping at 00:17 — after Iris, before Theo. Altered humidity spikes look faked.
onSolve.monologue: Logs don't lie, but people who edit logs do. Midnight studio ping… Rowan, your alibi is wilting.

uv_kiln.name: UV Residue on Kiln
uv_kiln.requiresMsg: Something oily caught the light. If only I had inspection chalk…

junior.hint: Select UV chalk (or UV kit) in inventory, then tap the kiln.

senior.hint: Use the right tool on the kiln to reveal residue.

master.hint: Residue fades — reapply chalk if needed.

onSolve.notebook: UV chalk reveals kiln-brick dust trail from pedestal path to annealing kiln. Hollow brick?
onSolve.monologue: Hello, clandestine brickwork. Someone ferried the orchid like contraband pastry.

uv_pedestal.name: Pedestal Residue Sample
uv_pedestal.requiresMsg: Need the UV sample kit (combine tweezers + chalk) on the pedestal base.

junior.hint: Combine tweezers + UV chalk, then use the kit on the pedestal.

senior.hint: Lift residue from the pedestal base with the UV kit.

onSolve.notebook: Pedestal base: kiln-brick micro-dust. Same trail as the annealing kiln.
onSolve.monologue: Residue bridge confirmed. Pedestal to kiln — one continuous guilty path.

onSolve.notebook: Act I: Pedestal scratch = tungsten; UV trail → kiln; climate log → midnight studio badge. Rowan is center stage — but clear the red herrings before you accuse.
onSolve.monologue: Trail, tool, and timestamp. Act I curtain — now clear Theo, Juliette, and Iris, then pry open that kiln.

shed_lock.name: Shed Padlock
shed_lock.requiresMsg: Padlock laughs at fingers. Need something thin and bent — studio scrap wire?

junior.hint: Select Bent Studio Wire, then tap the padlock.

senior.hint: Use a bent wire on the shed lock.

onSolve.notebook: Shed unlocked with bent studio wire. Search inside for Theo's paperwork.

oven_keypad.name: Annealing Oven Keypad
oven_keypad.requiresMsg: Oven wants a three-step temp recipe. Find Liora's notes.
oven_keypad.intro: ANNEAL SAFE — enter temperature sequence as a 9-digit code (soak+ramp+hold).

senior.hint: Sequence from Liora's recipe math: soak → ramp → hold.

onSolve.notebook: Oven safe opened. Studio keycard acquired — fits the hollow kiln brick latch.
onSolve.monologue: Keycard slides out like a confession. Time to open that brick.

hollow_brick.name: Hollow Kiln Brick
hollow_brick.requiresMsg: Hollow brick latch — need the studio keycard (and leverage helps).
hollow_brick.alsoNeedsMsg: Keycard clicks, but the brick won't budge. Need a crowbar from the night service door.

junior.hint: Select Studio Keycard (have crowbar in inventory), tap the hollow brick.

senior.hint: Keycard + crowbar on the hollow kiln brick.

master.hint: UV trail should still be fresh; use keycard and crowbar.

onSolve.notebook: ORCHID RECOVERED from hollow kiln brick. Rowan's 'protective' stash. Build the accusation on the cottage evidence board.
onSolve.monologue: There you are — cool, intact, furious. Hello, Glass Orchid. Time to pin this properly.

badge_sort.name: Badge Log Timeline
badge_sort.requiresMsg: Need Celeste's badge fragment and the climate log first.
badge_sort.intro: Drag events into chronological order. Distractors included.

junior.hint: Junior: 4 events — Iris check-in → studio midnight → dawn Theo → morning Celeste.

senior.hint: Sort real badge pings; discard alibi fluff.

master.hint: Infer the missing stamp: studio ping sits between Iris and Theo.

onSolve.notebook: Badge timeline sorted: Rowan's studio ping at 00:17 sits between Iris and Theo — matches climate edit window.
onSolve.monologue: Timeline sings. Midnight studio visit — not a coffee run.

bequest_page.name: Reassemble Torn Bequest
bequest_page.intro: Order the watermark strips to reassemble Liora's bequest page.

junior.hint: Junior: watermark flows left→right: PUBLIC → REMAIN → NO SALE.

events.label: Strip C: 'Private SALE voids the gift.'

senior.hint: Follow the watermark river through the strips.

events.label: Strip C: 'Private SALE voids the gift.'

onSolve.notebook: Bequest reassembled: sculpture must stay public; private sale voids gift. Juliette's pressure play is illegal against the bequest.
onSolve.monologue: Liora lawyered from beyond. Private sale? Not on her watch.

service_door.name: Night Service Door
service_door.requiresMsg: Daytime: bolted and boring. Come back at night.

junior.hint: Switch to Night at the cottage, then check this door.

onSolve.notebook: Night service door: crowbar stashed behind the jamb. Theo mentioned the squeak — useful leverage for the kiln brick.
onSolve.monologue: Night delivers: one crowbar, slightly guilty, deeply useful.

latin_labels.name: Orchid Latin Labels
latin_labels.intro: Match the Latin tag to the correct bench. Iris would be proud (quietly).

junior.hint: Cattleya is the showy corsage orchid on Bench 3.

senior.hint: Bench 3 hosts the cattleya — same number as the climate PIN suffix.

onSolve.notebook: Latin labels sorted. Educational win; Iris nods approvingly in spirit.
onSolve.monologue: Binomials conquered. Detectives can be nerds. In fact, we must.

glass_formula.name: Glass Formula Quiz
glass_formula.intro: Liora's signature glass: which oxide ratio marks her batch (and proves the sweepings are fakes)?

junior.hint: Junior: high silica, low lead — her 'singing' batch.

senior.hint: Match oxide ratios from studio lore.

onSolve.notebook: Formula quiz: planted shards are high-lead, not Liora's singing silica batch.
onSolve.monologue: Fake shards unmasked. Someone wanted a smash narrative.

seating_cipher.name: Gala Seating Cipher
seating_cipher.intro: Initials on the seating chart fold into locker digits. JC=10, TH=20, RV=18 → ?

senior.hint: Map initials to jersey-style numbers, concatenate in chart order JC-TH-RV.

onSolve.notebook: Seating cipher: 102018. Optional flavor — Finn may nod harder at your rumors.
onSolve.monologue: Numbers from names. Gala planners are accidental cryptographers.

finn_crossword.name: Finn's Rumor Crossword
finn_crossword.intro: Across: 'Protective thief with kiln access (5 letters)'. Finn grins like a fox.

onSolve.notebook: Finn's crossword points at Rowan — rumor with teeth.
onSolve.monologue: Even the café crossword is snitching. Noted.

evidence_board.name: Final Evidence Board
evidence_board.requiresMsg: Recover the orchid first — then pin the proof.
evidence_board.intro: Pin three proofs to accuse. Wrong pins on Senior sting; Junior slots glow faintly when correct.

junior.warning: You can accuse now, but clearing Iris, Theo, and Juliette first makes the case airtight.

senior.clearsMsg: Senior Detective: clear Iris (tissue), Theo (watch), and Juliette (lawyer) before the final accuse.

master.clearsMsg: Master: three clears plus sorted badge timeline required.

onSolve.notebook: Accusation locked: Rowan Vale — tungsten tool, midnight badge, hollow kiln stash. Protective theft + panic framing.
onSolve.monologue: Board complete. Time to talk to Rowan — with receipts.

onSolve.notebook: Case closed. Orchid recovered. Rowan faces restitution. Juliette's sale scheme exposed. Celeste reforms gala contracts.
onSolve.monologue: Curtain. The Hollow keeps its orchid — and I keep my standards.
